name: reordered-inner
sql: SELECT x.id,y.id FROM m x JOIN m y ON x.a=y.a WHERE y.id=1

table.name: m
table.sql: CREATE TABLE m(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,a INTEGER,b INTEGER,c INTEGER)

name: left-barrier
sql: SELECT x.id,y.id FROM m x LEFT JOIN m y ON y.id=x.id AND y.b>2

name: right-barrier
sql: SELECT y.id,z.id FROM m x RIGHT JOIN m y ON x.id=-1 LEFT JOIN m z ON z.id=y.id

name: multislot-in
sql: SELECT x.id,y.id FROM m x JOIN m y INDEXED BY m_abc ON y.a IN (1,2) AND y.b IN (2,3) WHERE x.id=1

name: prefix
sql: SELECT x.id,y.id FROM m x JOIN m y INDEXED BY m_abc ON y.b=2 WHERE x.id=1

name: auto-bloom
sql: SELECT x.id,y.id FROM m x JOIN m y ON y.b=x.b JOIN m z ON z.a=y.a WHERE x.id<5

name: selected-prefix
sql: SELECT x.id,z.id,y.id FROM t x CROSS JOIN t z CROSS JOIN t y INDEXED BY ab WHERE x.id<3 AND z.id<3 AND y.b=199 AND y.c=0 ORDER BY x.id,z.id,y.id

table.name: t
table.sql: CREATE TABLE t(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,a INTEGER,b INTEGER,c INTEGER,p TEXT)

name: selected-borrow
sql: SELECT x.id,y.id FROM t x CROSS JOIN tiny z CROSS JOIN t y WHERE y.a=99 AND y.b=x.b AND y.s='cold' ORDER BY x.id,y.id

index.name: ab
index.sql: CREATE INDEX ab ON t(a,b DESC)

table.name: t
table.sql: CREATE TABLE t(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,a INTEGER,b INTEGER,r REAL,s TEXT)

indexes.name: sr
indexes.sql: CREATE INDEX sr ON t(s COLLATE rtrim)

indexes.name: sn
indexes.sql: CREATE INDEX sn ON t(s COLLATE nocase)

name: two-filter-borrow
sql: SELECT x.id,r.id,y.id FROM t x CROSS JOIN tiny z CROSS JOIN t r JOIN t y WHERE r.a=99 AND r.b=x.b AND r.s='cold' AND y.a=98 AND y.b=x.b AND y.s='cold' ORDER BY x.id,r.id,y.id
